It operates through Liner, Bulk, Tanker, Technical & Offshore, and Others segments. The company's fleet comprises bulk carriers, crude oil tankers, product tankers, container vessels, passenger-cum-cargo vessels, LPG carriers, and offshore supply vessels.

SICALLOG.NS.d: Sical Logistics Limited, founded in 1955 and based in Bengaluru, provides integrated logistics across India. It handles dry and liquid bulk cargo at ports, runs a container terminal at Tuticorin and freight stations in Chennai, Vizag and Tuticorin, and offers customs brokerage, vessel chartering, shipping agency and stevedoring. It also moves bulk, project and oversized cargo by road.

SMARTLINK.NS.d: Smartlink Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, markets, distributes, and services networking products in India. The company operates in two segments, Investment and Networking Products. It offers networking products, such as switches, broadband routers, wireless LANs, and GPON and GePON under the DIGISOL brand name.

SPMLINFRA.NS.d: SPML Infra Limited operates as an infrastructure development company in India. It operates in two segments, Construction and Trading. The company undertakes urban water supply and distribution, and water treatment projects; constructs pumping stations for water supply, irrigation, wastewater, and storm water drainage; and designs and supplies bulk and distribution pipeline networks, as well as provides services in various areas, including construction of dams, canals, lift irrigation, micro irrigation, and…

SRTRANSFIN-Z7.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 9.5% Sr.V represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 9.5% and belonging to Series V of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

SRTRANSFIN-ZA.NS.d: Sec Red NCD Sr.VIII represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, belonging to Series VIII of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

TANLA.NS.d: Tanla Platforms Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides cloud communication services for mobile operators and enterprises in India and internationally.

UNOMINDA.NS.d: UNO Minda Limited, headquartered in Gurugram and established in 1958, is an automotive components maker with an international presence, known as Minda Industries Limited until July 2022. It designs, develops, produces and sells auto parts, mainly to original equipment manufacturers, for two-wheelers and other vehicle types.

VALIANTLAB.NS.d: Valiant Laboratories Limited is an India-based maker of active pharmaceutical ingredients and bulk drugs for domestic and export customers. Its main product is paracetamol, produced in grades meeting Indian, British, European and US pharmacopoeia standards. It also supplies specialty chemicals. It was established in 1980 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

VERA-SM.NS.d: VERA SYNTHETIC LTD is an Indian textile company. The company specializes in the manufacturing and trading of synthetic fabrics. Vera Synthetic is based in India.

YESBANK.NS.d: Yes Bank Limited provides banking and financial services primarily in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company offers corporate banking services, such as working capital finance, term loans, corporate finance, trade finance and cash management services, debt capital markets, treasury, liquidity management, and other services.
